subject: DPA negotiation: subprocessor carve-outs, UK addendum, eSign routing
messages:

Cc: DataHarbor Legal <privacy@dataharbor.com>

Subject: DPA redlines and subprocessor inventory (round 1)

Vivek —

Thanks for the call earlier. Attached are DataHarbor's initial redlines to the standard DPA (see DataHarbor_DPA_Redlines_v1.docx) and our current subprocessor list (subprocessor_inventory_20271005.csv). High-level asks:

- Carve out for our bank integrations (MercuryBank) around financial audit assistance — we flagged Section 4.2.
- UK Addendum: we requested an explicit reference to UK Addendum / UK SCCs for UK-resident data; see comments inline.
- Transfer mechanisms: we propose an approach that references SCCs + vendor attestations rather than a generic transfer clause.

We're available to discuss the carve-outs and thought a 30-minute call would help resolve the bank-related clause. Can you run this by your privacy counsel and confirm what evidence you can provide for our procurement team (SCCs matrix, subprocessors with locations, and any HSM/KMS attestations)?

Also please confirm the DocuSign flow — we prefer DataHarbor to originate the envelope so our procurement system can auto-ingest signed docs (we use DocuSign).

Thanks,
Amelia Soto
Senior Counsel, DataHarbor
amelia@dataharbor.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Amelia Soto <amelia@dataharbor.com>
Date: 2027-10-06T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: RE: DPA redlines and subprocessor inventory (round 1) — counsel comments

Team / Amelia —

Thanks — I reviewed DataHarbor's redlines and compiled counsel-level comments and a proposed compromise. High-level summary below; full inline comments are in the attached SCCs_matrix.pdf and I have annotated the Word with tracked changes (sending internally to Laura for finalization).

1) Bank integration carve-out (Section 4.2):
- We cannot agree to an unrestricted carve-out for bank audits. Proposed compromise: limited assistance obligation (reasonable cooperation + scope-limited to audit evidence specific to the Payment Integration) and DataHarbor to route requests through an approved procurement contact. Suggested language: "Customer will provide a specific audit scope and data subjects; Redwood will provide cooperation reasonably necessary to support audit, subject to Redwood's confidentiality and security policies."

2) UK Addendum / Transfers:
- For UK-resident data we accept signing the UK Addendum but require that it be clearly referenced as an annex to avoid duplicative/conflicting terms. We propose: Redwood executes the UK Addendum concurrently; both documents to be attached in DocuSign as separate envelope documents.

3) Subprocessors & evidence:
- We will provide the current subprocessor inventory (CSV) and an SCCs_matrix.pdf mapping by subprocessor and location. We cannot provide raw HSM keys but can provide KMS vendor attestations and a statement of encryption key custody.

4) Execution / eSign flow:
- DocuSign is fine. We recommend Redwood originate the envelope for tracking parity with our ContractOps system unless DataHarbor's procurement requires ingestion from their side. If DataHarbor must originate the envelope, we will request they include Redwood's ContractOps custom metadata fields (vendor_id, deal_id).

5) Timeline & next steps:
- Laura will prepare a tracked-change Word with the compromise language and return by 10/06 5pm PT.
- Monica will coordinate MercuryBank procurement contact details and confirm whether the bank requires a separate addendum.

Amelia — can you confirm whether DataHarbor requires the UK Addendum signed by a separate signatory? That will affect DocuSign routing (multiple signers / countersign order).

Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

Attachments: SCCs_matrix.pdf (PDF, 190 KB)

From: Amelia Soto <amelia@dataharbor.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-06T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines and subprocessor inventory (round 1) — counsel comments

Neha —

Thanks for the quick review and the proposed compromises — that helps a lot. A few clarifications from procurement/legal side: 

- UK Addendum: DataHarbor requires a signature from our UK contracting desk (separate signatory). We can include both docs in a single DocuSign envelope but will need routing that has the UK signatory sign the Addendum before Redwood countersigns.
- Bank audit carve-out: our bank (MercuryBank) is adamant about specific assistance language. If Redwood provides the limited assistance language you outlined, we'll take it to our procurement and revert.
- Evidence ingestion: we prefer to originate DocuSign (procurement system integration). If we originate, can Redwood accept the envelope and countersign programmatically? Alternatively, can Redwood provide the ContractOps metadata fields listed below so our system can tag the doc?

Requested metadata fields: vendor_id (DH-2027-034), contract_type (DPA), internal_procurement_id (MB-7782).

We are happy to hop on a quick call tomorrow (10/07) with procurement and MercuryBank technical contact to finalize the audit scope. Proposed times: 9am PT or 1pm PT. Which works?

Best,
Amelia

Amelia / Team —

Thanks—good progress. Quick summary of agreed next steps so procurement has a clear playbook:

1) DocuSign flow: DataHarbor to originate the envelope (per preference). DataHarbor to include ContractOps metadata: vendor_id=DH-2027-034, contract_type=DPA, internal_procurement_id=MB-7782. We will confirm programmatic acceptance and countersign by 10/08 EOD PT.
2) UK Addendum: Because DataHarbor needs a UK signatory, we'll include the Addendum as a separate document in the same envelope and ensure routing order has UK signatory -> Redwood countersign.
3) Evidence bundle: Redwood will upload SCCs_matrix.pdf and a redacted subprocessor inventory to the shared Drive folder (https://drive.redwood/workspace/DH-2027-034/evidence) by 10/08 noon PT. Full inventory will be available under NDA if procurement requires additional detail.
4) Bank audit carve-out: Laura will send the tracked-change Word with the limited assistance language by 10/06 (Laura: please confirm you shared final). If procurement accepts, we'll incorporate into the envelope.

Monica / Laura / Neha — please confirm when the annotated Word is ready and that the SCCs matrix link is live. Amelia: tentatively accept 10/07 9am PT for the call with MercuryBank — please send calendar invite and join details.

Thanks,
Vivek
